card.name: Size words after a measurement
card.fires_on: Dimension words such as long, tall, high, length, or "as" in "as tall as", right after a number with a unit of length. Also the word just before a qualifier on a size.

modes.label: Dimension word after measure
modes.description: Long, tall, high or length placed right after a number and length unit in a description of an object or animal.
modes.example: Steelcraft’s Chrysler was 50-inches<< long>>, and could be yours for only $

modes.label: Word after a size phrase
modes.description: A word like not or as that follows a size and leads into a qualifier or comparison.
modes.example: Golden lion Tamarins are about 8-13 inches long<< not>> including the tail.

card.writes: It pushes toward size and dimension words such as taller, compact, and scrollHeight, and away from unrelated name fragments.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where an object's length, height, or size has just been given.
